pcs.pc_description: clean the concrete apron and debris in the well
check the concrete apron and well seal for cracks and repair with cement mortar as needed
check the condition of the rope, pulley, support posts, bucket and fence and repair or replace when needed.

record the water level with a rope scale
repair any structural damage to the well and surrounding structure
dewater the well and clean the bottom
inspect the well walls and lining and repair as needed
check the water level and deepen/de-silt the well especially in monsoon

tighten the handle axle nut and lock nut
verify whether hand pump is firm on its base and fix it if needed
open the cover and clean inside the pump
dismantle the hand pump for inspection/cleaning and reassemble after inspection

verify the discharge of water
verify the handle position and repair if needed
verify whether guide bush, roller chain is not excessively worn out and replace if needed
clean and de-calcify pump components
take action as per standard operating procedure to troubleshoot faults occurring in the hand pump

check for leaks in the rising main
remove the pump and rising main from the well and inspect
inspect pipes, electric cables, insulation between cables
record servicing and maintenance in logbook
re-cut corroded or damaged threads and replace badly corroded pipes
de-silt borehole if required
take action as per standard operating procedure to troubleshoot faults occurring in the tube or bore well

interpret relevant information from water quality report
share water quality test results with appropriate authorities
